displayedVersion: 1.0.0, previously verified in the same retained document
data: Own synthetic Archiv, Nera and Die flüsternden Listen pages only
steps: Opened existing Archiv from the recent-pages link.
Created another block at the end of the existing room note. Entered the same twelve-paragraph room text, clue and exit used in our native case, plus Spur für später: [[Die flüsternden Listen]].
Escape confirmed the block. Shift-clicking the newly named page reference opened its empty target in the right sidebar while Archiv stayed in the main pane.
Clicked Click here to edit... in the new sidebar page, entered the selected clue paragraph plus the next-session question, and confirmed with Escape.
Observed the new text on the sidebar page and its automatic linked reference back to Archiv. The main Archiv page stayed in place.
observations: Creating a page reference creates the target identity and backlink without a separate page-creation form or later manual linking.
The new page was initially empty: the clue text still had to be transferred into it. No automatic text-selection prefill was observed in the performed route.
Knowing [[page]] syntax and Shift-click enabled the short route. This is the tested route, not a claim about every available route.
The entire long referring block was repeated in the sidebar backlink, which consumed substantial vertical space; a hover preview also briefly covered part of the room text.
limits: Demo explicitly warns that edits are not saved without a local directory. No directory was granted. No disk or restart acceptance claimed.
No human usability timing, whole-product ranking or general superiority claim.
